# Vendored front-end libraries

Served from here instead of a CDN so the landing page works on a board or a
workshop network without internet access.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `marked.min.js` | marked | 11.1.0 | MIT |
| `purify.min.js` | DOMPurify | 3.2.6 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |
| `highlight.min.js` | highlight.js | 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `atom-one-dark.min.css` | highlight.js theme | 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause |

Update by downloading the same file names for the new version from
cdn.jsdelivr.net or cdnjs.cloudflare.com and changing the table above.
